items.title: Another Cracked Fuselage: Amerijet Boeing 767-300F Damaged After Hard Landing In Guatemala
items.summary: A Boeing 767-300F operated by US cargo carrier Amerijet International sustained fuselage damage after a hard landing at Guatemala City's La Aurora International Airport earlier in September. The aircraft, which was operating flight 8743, arrived in Guatemala after being diverted amid a flight from Miami International to Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport.
